summary.intent: Capture implementation decisions for Phase 20 (Vault Migration) by discussing gray areas with the user and writing a CONTEXT.md that downstream research and planning agents can act on.
summary.outcome: CONTEXT.md was written to .planning/phases/20-vault-migration/20-CONTEXT.md with decisions across migration trigger, login read strategy, cross-client write scope, IPNS key deprecation, and system readiness. The file was committed on a feature branch after an initial failed attempt to commit to main.

repo: Vault blob v2 format: 0x02 | uint16 key_length | ECIES_key | AES_GCM_metadata — defined in ARCHITECTURE.md research doc
DB columns encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey both exist on the vault entity and are both targeted for NULL-then-eventual-drop after migration
IPNS key is HKDF-derivable, making the stored DB copy redundant — already verified in desktop Rust code
Kubo is the current IPFS performance bottleneck; infra fixes are in-flight, which is why silent DB fallback is the safety net for Phase 20
Phase 18 added server-side Prometheus histograms for IPNS resolve/publish; Phase 22 will add end-to-end login-to-vault journey timing
Migration strategy: dual-write (v2 blob + DB), version-aware read, per-user phased rollout via migratedAt timestamp
Five-package SDK architecture established in Phase 19.1 — vault init and blob v2 logic belongs in @cipherbox/core

code.finding: Contains encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey columns targeted for NULL-then-drop
Vault initialization logic in @cipherbox/core — blob v2 TypeScript implementation will live here
Vault type definitions in shared core package
API-side vault service — will need to accept but ignore IPNS key on init after deprecation
Web client vault store — needs update to write v2 blob on root folder publish
Desktop Rust vault commands — needs Rust equivalent of blob v2 logic; IPNS key HKDF-derivability already verified here

workflow: The gsd discuss-phase workflow scouts the codebase and loads prior CONTEXT.md files to avoid re-asking already-decided questions
Canonical refs section in CONTEXT.md is mandatory — downstream agents need full relative paths to specs/ADRs, not inline mentions
Auto-advance via --auto flag chains discuss → plan → execute at the same nesting level to avoid deep agent nesting freezes

friction: Git commit failed due to 1Password signing agent not being available in the subprocess — required manual intervention from user
Claude initially attempted to commit directly to main branch instead of creating a feature branch first, requiring user correction
System readiness gray area was poorly framed initially — the question was too narrow and the user had to clarify context about baselines and Kubo performance
open_items: Column DROP migration for encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey — deferred until all users have migrated
IPFS-only retry-then-error mode (no silent DB fallback) — deferred until Kubo performance improvements prove out
Client-side end-to-end 'first login → fully loaded vault' baseline metrics — covered by Phase 22 instrumentation, not Phase 20
Kubo performance fixes — in-flight infrastructure work, not part of Phase 20 scope
Recovery tool update to parse blob v2 format — scoped to Phase 20 but not yet implemented
